images.title: Doubling and giving away
images.purpose: Shows Asha's stickers followed as x through two rounds of doubling and giving away 5.
images.composition: One horizontal chain of three rounded boxes, then the final value and the answer.
images.exact_structure: Three rounded boxes in one row, white fill, dark outline, holding x, 2x − 5 and 4x − 15, joined by two arrows. Above each arrow, in teal #0072B2: × 2, − 5 (the same label appears twice, once on each arrow). After the third box: = 13 in dark numerals. Below the chain, centred: x = 7 in reddish purple #CC79A7. Nothing else is drawn. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, which is large and centred; no scenery, no people, no other text.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Follow x through every round, then solve.
images.description: Shows Asha's stickers followed as x through two rounds of doubling and giving away 5.
images.context: Picture for undoing a chain of doubling and giving away.

image_decisions.why: The chain shows each round as one step, so the child sees the expression grow before solving.
